blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is unit mein kya seekhenge)
Is unit ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Programming ke bunyadi concepts (buniyadi tasawwurat) samajh sakenge aur Python ka development environment (kaam ka setup) tayyar kar sakenge.
Python ka bunyadi syntax (likhne ka qaida) aur structure likh aur samajh sakenge, jaise variables, data types aur input/output.
Python mein mukhtalif operators aur expressions istemal kar sakenge: arithmetic (hisaab wale), comparison (muqabla karne wale) aur logical operators.
Python mein control structures bana sakenge, jaise decision-making statements (faisla karne wale statements) aur loops (dohrane wale hisse).
Python modules, functions aur built-in data structures, jaise lists, ke sath kaam kar sakenge.
Python mein modular programming (program ko chhote hisson mein baantna) aur object-oriented programming ke concepts istemal kar sakenge.
Python mein exceptions (chalte program ki ghaltiyan) sambhal sakenge, files par kaam kar sakenge, aur testing aur debugging (ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karna) ke tareeqe istemal kar sakenge.

blocks.text: Python programming ki dunya mein khush aamdeed! Python ek mashhoor aur versatile (har kaam mein kaam aane wali) language hai. Yeh apni simplicity (saadgi) aur readability (parhne mein aasani) ki wajah se naye seekhne walon aur professionals dono ke liye behtareen hai. Is chapter mein hum bunyadi baaton se shuru karenge: apna development environment tayyar karna aur programming ke bunyadi concepts seekhna. Phir hum aage ke topics parhenge, jaise modular programming, file handling, debugging aur data structures. Chapter ke aakhir tak aap Python achhi tarah samajh jayenge aur apne programs aur Command Line Interface (CLI) applications khud likh, test aur debug kar sakenge.

Python ek bohat istemal hone wali high-level programming language hai jo apni saadgi aur readability ke liye mashhoor hai. Yeh kai shobon (fields) mein kaam aati hai, jaise web development, data analysis aur artificial intelligence. Is ka syntax (likhne ke qawaid) seedha aur banawat saaf hai, is liye naye seekhne wale mushkil qawaid mein uljhne ki bajaye programming ke concepts par dhyan de sakte hain. Chhota sa script likhna ho ya bara software, Python jaldi aur aasani se kaam shuru karwa deti hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Python ka naam British comedy series "Monty Python's Flying Circus" par rakha gaya hai, saanp (snake) par nahi!

blocks.prompt: Teen shobe bataiye jahan Python istemal hoti hai aur ek wajah ke yeh naye seekhne walon ke liye kyun munasib hai.
blocks.explanation: Web development, data analysis aur artificial intelligence; is ka saada, parhne mein aasan syntax naye seekhne walon ko pecheeda qawaid ki bajaye programming ke khayalat par tawajjo dene deta hai.

items: Python: mashhoor high-level language, saada aur parhne mein aasan.
Web development, data analysis aur AI mein istemal hoti hai.
Chapter bunyadi baaton se modules, OOP, files, testing aur CLI applications tak jata hai.
